title: Support legacy positional parameters alongside trailing options objects in codegen

violation.problem: Codegen exclusively groups optional parameters into a trailing options object (e.g. generate(prompt, options?: { deviceType?: ... })), breaking 0.x positional invocations like generate(prompt, 'MOBILE') or createProject('Title').
violation.expectedSolution: Emit polymorphic signatures or overloads that accept either the legacy positional arguments or the trailing options object (e.g. deviceTypeOrOptions?: DeviceType | GenerateOptions), normalizing to the tool arguments object at runtime.
